prior_result: Attempt 2 reached the intended unit-local OOM at exactly MemoryMax=128M; systemd reported Result=oom-kill and journaled both the main kill and child cleanup. The collector then failed because the manager had removed ControlGroup after the unit stopped.
change: Persist a tiny worker-side cgroup/property receipt outside the worker before allocation, and collect OOM evidence from retained systemd unit properties and journal instead of requiring a cgroup directory that systemd has already removed.
acceptance: A complete JSON receipt proves systemd Result=oom-kill, peak=MemoryMax, group OOM enabled before allocation and child kill in the journal, plus unchanged invoking and Codex PIDs.
